founder_description_sefer: Fixes the fundamental flaws in the fabric of reality, or at least tries to.
founder_description_vlad: Specializes in controlling chaos and decay, both in systems and society.
project_trakt_line: Remembers every show you swore you'd finish.
project_kelp_line: A git client so light it forgets it's running.
project_stdusk_line: A terminal that drops from the sky and talks back.
wd_tagline: We build websites and web apps.
wd_narration_1: You come to in a small software studio. The monitors are still on. Somewhere, a build is failing.
wd_narration_2: Two people are here. One is wearing sunglasses indoors. The other is staring at a screen full of stars.
wd_option_sefer: "And the one staring at the stars?"
wd_portrait_label: {name}, hover or tap to reveal colour
wd_blaze: You fanned it into a blaze. Somewhere, a fire inspector weeps.
wd_vlad_line_1: Sunglasses indoors. He has controlled worse chaos than this.
wd_vlad_line_2: The tattoos say he has lived. Ask him where the good coffee is.
wd_vlad_line_3: Laziness: 1. This man has never once closed a laptop at five.
wd_sefer_line_1: He is debugging something. Possibly you.
wd_sefer_line_2: The stars behind him are stack traces. Do not ask which ones are yours.
wd_sefer_line_3: Six out of six. He takes the crown, and he did not even get up for it.
we_caption: 8 thoughts orbiting. Pick one to internalize.
we_weekend_line: It's the weekend. Sefer was right all along.
we_arcana_sub: Two founders · tap a card to turn it
we_epilogue: The cabinet is full. You are now 100% Hoboware.
we_sleep: You did absolutely nothing for twenty seconds. Sefer is proud of you.
we_wake: Back to work. Or not. It's the weekend.
we_card_label: {arcana}: {name}. Press Enter to turn the card.
we_mosaic_cap_start: Portrait of the hobo, set in
we_mosaic_cap_end: hype lines. Touch it to rewrite him.
seo_title: Hoboware | Web studio for websites and web apps
seo_description: Hoboware is a small web studio run by Vlad Jerca and Sefer Turan. We design and build fast websites and web apps, and work on Trakt, kelp and stdusk.
og_image_alt: The Hoboware logo glowing as pixel coals, with the line: We build websites and web apps. They argue back.
og_image_alt_weekend: The Hoboware hobo drawn in letters from our hype lines, with the line: It's the weekend. Sefer was right all along.
